environment.julia_dependency_scope: Historical Phase 3 and Objective Validation discovery engines only. NOT required for prospective paper benchmark.

clean_clone_with_sympy_installed.failure_root_cause: Missing artifacts/p2_compounds.parquet in test_ov_pipeline.py and test_ov_blinding.py

artifact_audit.description: 550-compound structural metadata table (Murcko scaffold, scaffold group, Butina cluster, confirmation seal split indicator) derived during Phase 2 from MassBank development corpus.
artifact_audit.original_source: Generated by scripts/t2_02_splits.py from artifacts/p2_dev_corpus.parquet (which stems from MassBank raw data and scripts/t1_build_trajectories.py -> artifacts/trajectories.parquet).
artifact_audit.impact_on_paper_benchmark: NONE. The prospective paper benchmark is 100% synthetic, self-contained in src/muru/paper_benchmark/, and has no dependency on p2_compounds.parquet or real-data artifacts.

missing_mandatory_dependencies.rationale: Directly imported by prospective benchmark modules (muru.paper_benchmark.g2_contract, muru.paper_benchmark.g3_contract) and discovery modules (muru.discovery.grammar, equivalence, falsify). Missing from requirements.lock.txt causes test collection failure.

missing_optional_historical_dependencies.rationale: Required only if re-running historical Phase 3 or Objective Validation PySR symbolic regression searches.
Required only if re-running historical genetic programming baseline searches.
Managed automatically by PySR/juliapkg when pysr is installed.

artifact_files_with_hardcoded_paths.impact: Manifest.read(MANIFEST).verify() defaults to self.root if root is not passed as an argument, causing verification to fail on external clones.

recommended_repairs.action: Add sympy==1.14.0 and mpmath==1.3.0 to requirements.lock.txt so clean venvs can collect and run all benchmark contracts.
Add pytest.skip guards to cov fixture and test functions calling load_dev_covariates() when artifacts/p2_compounds.parquet is absent, matching the existing pattern in test_p3_generators.py.

Change root field in MANIFEST_massbank.json from absolute path to relative path 'data/massbank/MassBank-data/LCSB' matching MANIFEST_mzml.json convention, and support relative root rebasing in Manifest.verify().
Update README.md reproduction instructions to document Phase 3, Objective Validation, and Paper Benchmark suites, and replace hardcoded /Users/aryav paths with relative repo root references.
